title: Glen Powell’s ‘Comeback King’ trailer packs country star power, but divides fans
text:
'The Comeback King' features cameos from Reba McEntire, Miranda Lambert, Jelly Roll and more country music stars

Reba McEntire poses for photos on the ACM Awards red carpet

2025 ACM Awards host Reba McEntire wore a black suit while she posed for a group photo on the red carpet. Her boyfriend, Rex Linn, stood back while his leading lady had her moment.

Glen Powell is cracking beers and throwing on cowboy boots in his upcoming comedy, "The Comeback King."

The first trailer, which debuted Nov. 18, offered fans a glimpse of Powell as Aubrey King, a country music superstar whose career comes crashing down after a public breakup with his pop star girlfriend Missy, played by "Outer Banks" star Madelyn Cline.

King discovers Missy is cheating on him, but she goes on to make a breakup anthem that makes it seem like he was unfaithful.

The comedy features appearances from some of country music's biggest names, including Reba McEntire, Miranda Lambert, Jelly Roll, Brad Paisley, Chris Stapleton, Luke Bryan and Shaboozey. In one memorable trailer moment, McEntire's character confronts Powell after he accidentally punches her during an altercation.

GLEN POWELL REVEALS WILD NIGHT WITH COUNTRY STARS ENDED WITH BEER PONG AT JELLY ROLL’S NASHVILLE BAR

The first trailer for "The Comeback King," starring Glen Powell, was released Nov. 18. (Michael Tran/AFP via Getty Images)

McEntire responds by tackling King to the ground and pulling out a pocket knife.

"I’m Reba frickin’ McEntire," the Queen of Country says. "How do you wanna die?"

The trailer quickly generated conversation online, with viewers offering a range of reactions to Powell's latest big-screen venture. While some fans were immediately sold on the actor's country music transformation and the movie's impressive lineup of celebrity cameos, others questioned whether the comedy would deliver on its premise.

"First movie I've wanted to see in a long time," one user wrote on X.

"Glen Powell, Madelyn Cline, Megan Moroney and lots of other country artists," another added. "I'm so sat."

The movie poster for "The Comeback King" starring Glen Powell. (Universal Pictures)

"Glen Powell in a comedy like this? I'm already interested," one said. "This looks like it could be a fun watch. Can't wait to see how it turns out."

"Glen Powell playing a country star in free-fall is the most believable comeback pitch of 2027," another wrote.

But the excitement wasn't universal. Some social media users were quick to criticize the trailer, questioning whether the star-studded comedy would actually deliver laughs.

LIKE WHAT YOU'RE READING? CLICK HERE FOR MORE ENTERTAINMENT NEWS

Reba McEntire makes an unforgettable appearance in "The Comeback King." (Art Streiber/NBC via Getty Images)

"Is it just me or does this not look particularly funny," one user commented on X. "Seems more like a drama with a few funny lines. Judd Apatow has lost his ability to be funny."

Glen Powell's "The Comeback King" features a star-studded cast, including Reba McEntire, Jelly Roll, Brad Paisley and more. (Getty Images for BAFTA)

"I thought Glen Powell was our next Tom Cruise," a user said. "Only Steven Seagal can save us now."

"This looks atrocious," another added.

Glen Powell in "How to Make a Killing." (Ilze Kitshof/A24)

Powell rose to mainstream fame playing Lt. Jake "Hangman" Seresin opposite Cruise in "Top Gun: Maverick." His other notable projects include "Hidden Figures," "Anyone But You," "Hit Man" and "Twisters."

Sydney Sweeney and Glen Powell starred together in "Anyone But You." (Getty Images)

Beyond starring in "The Comeback King," Powell co-wrote the screenplay with Apatow and trained in singing and guitar to portray the fictional country singer. The movie marks another major step in Powell's expanding Hollywood career, combining his comedic talents with an unexpected musical turn.

The movie is set to hit theaters Feb. 5, 2027.
